problems.title: Didgeridoo
problems.statement: The ‘didgeridoo’ is a simple wind instrument traditionally made by the Australian Aborigines from a hollowed-out log. It is, however, a remarkable instrument because of the wide variety of timbres that it produces. Investigate the nature of the sounds that can be produced and how they are formed.
